messages.content: Do you ever wonder if you're the 'main character' or just a side character in everyone else's story?
Honestly, probably both depending who's telling it - that's kind of the strange thing about being a person around other people.
Fair, glad it landed that way - it takes some pressure off, genuinely, knowing you don't have to be central to every room you're in.
Yeah, I think I put too much pressure on being memorable to everyone.
That's honestly exhausting to carry, and probably unnecessary - being genuinely yourself with the people who matter does more than performing memorability for everyone.
